purpose: Technical tuxedo face legibility option at 80 CSS px: both eyes and line expressions must distinguish on the shared 128 px face set without changing face geometry or expression designs. This variant improves contrast but changes a visible coat marking; it is not approved for integration.

change.type: tuxedo body-only coat-appropriate cream face mask
change.integration: Copy the variant to runtime/bodies/tuxedo-legibility.svg and change only bodies[tuxedo].url in manifest.runtime.json. Keep bodies/tuxedo.svg and every original hash unchanged. No renderer or loader code change is needed; drawCat already loads the body URL from the manifest and the six shared faces are untouched.

geometry.silhouette: Original outer body path and clipPath are byte-identical. The added cream path is inside the existing body clip, has no stroke, and does not alter the silhouette, pivot, anchor, logical rect or collision geometry.

contrast.basis: WCAG 2.x sRGB relative-luminance formula on source flat colours; not a measured rendered-pixel or compliance claim.
contrast.sample: Right-eye centre of the idle face at 80 px logical body width; body-only render sampled before compositing the shared face.

evidence.capture: OpenBot private browser, static 80 px canvas sheet, deviceScaleFactor 1, no overlay labels or crosshairs. DPR2 is a 2x canvas backing shown downsampled; this is not a device-DPR screenshot and makes no game-loop/rAF timing claim.

checks.xmlDecode: Both files decoded by Chromium via HTMLImageElement in the review sheet; no separate XML parser run.
checks.dimensions: 512x384 width, height and viewBox on the variant.
checks.duplicateIds: none; coat and body are unique in the variant.
checks.alphaBounds: not measured; no collision geometry derived from alpha.
checks.allSixExpressions: Rendered at 80 px and DPR1/2 in the evidence pages; idle, focused, happy, surprised, worried and dizzy all show both eyes/brows and mouth.
checks.facesChanged: none; no per-coat face variant is required for this fix.
checks.beforeDefect: The original narrow blaze left the right eye/right brow on #494746; the dark face stroke merged with the coat at 80 px.

appearance.reason: The mask improves the right-eye/brow contrast, but the selected Grok tuxedo reference was independently reviewed by Architect as having dark eye surrounds and a cream muzzle/chest blaze, not a broad cream face. This variant therefore changes a visible marking and is offered as an option, not as a verified source-faithful correction.
appearance.scope: Legibility option for the existing tuxedo coat; no silhouette, expression or optional-coat scope change.
appearance.approval: Architect technical checks pass; integration is held for OG/user appearance review. Do not integrate until that decision is recorded. If rejected, the next step is a face-side variant that keeps the dark eye surrounds.

review.note: Architect independently viewed ../../../comparison-02/grok-cats.jpg; the eye surrounds are dark with yellow eyes, so the broad cream mask is a visible marking change.
